purpose: Render one plausibility view of the fixed San Jose nautical-twilight scene through a scene-specific cache page built from the complete actual-point N4 recurrence.

actualPointJ1Control.role: causal visual comparison only; not cache input or a correction term

physicalModel.scenePageJ1: evaluate directly at each requested actual page point; higher orders are seeded by direct L1, so no universal stored J1 field is required

temporarySolarZenith.status: initial POC construction control; not a qualified final resolution

temporaryField.semantic: pure-order radiance and scattering-density working fields

builderInterface.transportSpec: one immutable physical and numerical solver identity
builderInterface.scenePageRequests: ordered non-empty list; the first POC contains only the retained San Jose request
builderInterface.projectionScheduling: project every requested compatible page before releasing each wavelength's temporary field
builderInterface.incrementalAddition: a later immutable run may build additional independent pages without modifying prior page artifacts
builderInterface.universalFieldReuse: optional only when a separately preserved artifact has an exactly compatible identity and complete derivation record
builderInterface.pageIndependence: each page is independently stored, hashed, addressed, and loadable
builderInterface.collectionAssembly: a new immutable manifest may reference page artifacts from multiple preserved runs

scenePage.semantic: C4 cumulative local spectral scattering density

pageCompatibilityIdentity: position, incoming, outgoing, and spectral domains
prohibitedShortcuts: current receiver-column C4 as higher-order input
additive actual-point J1 outside the cache
Color or exposure repair of missing transport

output.required: one N4 San Jose plausibility render

resourcePolicy.offlineConstructionMemory: not a design constraint, optimization objective, or acceptance gate
resourcePolicy.backendAllocationFailure: select a capable offline backend or lossless field-safe chunking; do not reduce physical state, order, or final page semantics
